descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly Group Inventory
  description: Reviews all groups and reports on group types each week.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Retrieves all groups from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_group_type
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by type
    detail: Counts groups based on their groupTypes field.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - All
        - Security
        - Microsoft 365
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize group landscape
    detail: Generates a short report on group types.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You analyze Microsoft 365 group data and produce concise reports.
      prompt: >-
        Here are the counts of groups by type: {{ count_by_group_type.output }}.
        Write a brief summary of the group landscape, noting any significant
        trends or observations.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: weekly
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output }}'
    data:
      counts: '{{ count_by_group_type.output }}'

descriptor:
  id: top-noncompliant-models
  name: Top Noncompliant Models
  description: Lists the oldest managed devices by model and summarizes noncompliance.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: devices
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_devices
    format: graph
    label: Load managed devices
    detail: Retrieves managed devices from Microsoft Graph.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /deviceManagement/managedDevices
      select:
        - id
        - deviceName
        - model
        - complianceState
        - lastSyncDateTime
      scopes:
        - DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All
  - id: count_by_compliance
    format: transform
    label: Count devices by compliance state
    detail: Counts devices per complianceState value.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: complianceState
      buckets:
        - compliant
        - noncompliant
        - unknown
  - id: sort_oldest
    format: transform
    label: Sort devices by last sync date
    detail: Orders devices by lastSyncDateTime ascending and takes the first 10.
    settings:
      kind: sort-by
      source: "{{ load_devices.output }}"
      field: lastSyncDateTime
      direction: asc
      take: 10
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize findings
    detail: Generates a short report on device compliance.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You analyze managed devices for an organization. Provide concise, factual
        summaries.
      prompt: >-
        Here are the oldest 10 managed devices: {{ sort_oldest.output }}. The
        counts by compliance state are: {{ count_by_compliance.output }}. Write a
        brief report highlighting any notable noncompliance trends.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 200
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data:
      oldestDevices: "{{ sort_oldest.output }}"
      complianceCounts: "{{ count_by_compliance.output }}"

name: Dormant Guest Accounts
description: Reviews Microsoft 365 guest users and reports those that have been inactive for a long time.
slug: dormant-guest-accounts
category: security
tags:
  - microsoft 365
  - guest users
  - compliance
  - reporting
display:
  icon: account-multiple-check
  color: purple
  mode: read
definition:
  triggers:
    - type: manual
  variables:
    - name: days_inactive
      type: number
      label: Inactive for (days)
      default: 90
      required: true
  steps:
    - id: fetch_guest_users
      name: Load guest users
      type: microsoft.graph.listUsers
      settings:
        filter: userType eq 'Guest'
        select: id,displayName,userPrincipalName,createdDateTime,lastSignInDateTime
    - id: summarize
      name: Summarize dormant guests
      type: llm
      settings:
        model: gpt-4o-mini
        temperature: 0.2
        system: >-
          You are an assistant that reviews Microsoft 365 guest users and reports
          those that have been inactive for a long time. Provide a concise
          summary and a short list of the most notable accounts.
        prompt: >-
          Total guest users: {{ fetch_guest_users.total }}. Threshold: {{ days_inactive
          }} days. Data: {{ fetch_guest_users.result }}. Identify guests inactive for
          more than {{ days_inactive }} days and summarize findings.
  result:
    summary: "{{ summarize.output }}"
    data: "{{ summarize.output }}"
